## More of the compaction stream

- **The one-round compaction panel shows twice as much live text.** The streamed lane window kept 3 rows, which reduced the streamed summary to a tail that was hard to follow. It now keeps 6 rows — an ellipsis row plus the newest 5 lines — and the expanded window keeps 18 instead of 12.
- **It still cannot overflow.** The window reserves exactly the rows it draws, always keeps the newest lines, and clips the remainder, so a taller box stays inside its lane.

## Installers recommend PiTTy's own stack

- **The optional packages that installers offer are now ours.** `git:github.com/mistrjirka/pi-subagent` and `git:github.com/mistrjirka/pi-one-round-compaction` replace the legacy `npm:pi-subagents` and `npm:pi-smart-compact` entries; Todo and MCP adapter are unchanged.
- **Never two competing packages.** Each replacement is single-choice: if a machine already runs the legacy child-agent runtime or the alternative compaction engine, the installer skips our entry and says why instead of adding a second one.
- **Nothing is dropped.** The legacy runtime and the alternative compaction engine remain supported and documented in the README and the usage guide, together with their install commands.
- The install prompt lists missing packages by their real names, while detection keeps reading the strings `pi list` prints.

## Compatibility

- Existing installations are unaffected: an upgrade changes neither the packages already on the machine nor which panels appear. Live child streaming still needs `@mistrjirka/pi-subagent` 0.4.4 or newer, as documented.

## Validation

- PiTTy typecheck passed; complete local suite: **433 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed**; installer fixture suite: **6 passed, 0 failed**; `sh -n install.sh` reported no syntax errors.
